name: Six Robblees' Inc
old_description: Six Robblees' is your one-stop source for truck, trailer and tire shop supplies. It’s nice to know you have a partner who has been by your side since 1913. We look forward to serving you for the next 100 years!
about:
Six Robblees' Inc. traces its roots to 1913 when three brothers—Jim, Bill, and Herb Robblee—founded J.A. Robblee & Co. in Tacoma, Washington. The firm began as a bicycle repair shop before transitioning to racing car wheel work after World War I. By 1920 a second location opened in Seattle, and in 1930 the company was renamed Six Robblees' Inc. after Jim Robblee willed his share to his six remaining brothers. Today the business remains family-owned and is headquartered in Twin Falls, Idaho.

The company operates as a warehouse distributor of truck, trailer, and RV parts, as well as tire shop supplies and equipment. It stocks over 40,000 part numbers across 22 branches spanning eight states (Alaska, Montana, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Wyoming, California, and others). The network grew through acquisitions such as Union Rubber Company, Motor Wheel and Parts, and several Alaska-based firms. The distributor offers online account management and credit terms to its customers.

Six Robblees' serves the heavy-truck, light-truck, trailer, recreational vehicle, and tire-service sectors. Its customer base includes commercial fleets, independent repair shops, tire dealers, and RV service centers. The product range covers air brake components, axle and suspension parts, electrical wiring, exhaust components, fifth-wheel parts, hose assemblies, and a full line of tire service tools and TPMS accessories.

The business was built on the brothers' mechanical expertise and a focus on wheel-related products. Leadership has emphasized steady expansion through strategic purchases and membership in buying groups such as Heavy Duty America and Ascot Tire Supply to maintain a broad inventory and competitive pricing.
